name: Family at Home
source:
This Vn tells the story of a young boy named Alonso. He visits his aunt, Victoria, in her new house, along with his mother, Elizabeth, and his sister, Samantha.

The plan was to spend a weekend, but after a series of changes, he will be locked up with more than 5 women in a house, and he will be able to take advantage of this opportunity and spend many moments with them.

[From [url=https://salr-games.itch.io/family-at-home-final]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个Vn讲述了一个名叫阿隆索的小男孩的故事。他在姨妈维多利亚的新房子里拜访了她，还有他的母亲伊丽莎白和妹妹萨曼莎。

原本的计划是度过一个周末，但经过一系列的改变，他将和超过5个女人关在一个房子里，他将能够利用这个机会，与她们共度很多时光。

[来自[url=https://salr-games.itch.io/family-at-home-final]Itch.io[/url]]
